prompt: Photographs with a comparatively pale, broadly continuous sky occupying a substantial upper region and a darker, more detailed or silhouetted lower region.
looseness: Horizon height, boundary sharpness, fog density, foreground texture and subject matter may vary; slightly blue or pink-gray skies are allowed.
exclusions: Known derivatives, crops, related captures/sequences, synthetic imagery, dominant close-up subjects, saturated sunsets, and fog/cloud subjects without the light-upper/dark-lower composition.
interpretation: Visual curation only. Discovery buckets and source identities are not similarity labels or expected clusters.
